seasons.name: South Pole Summer 2027
seasons.description: 30-day sample near the lunar South Pole southern summer maximum; an approximate seasonal reference, not an Artemis IV operations window.

seasons.name: Equinox 2028
seasons.description: 30-day sample around the predicted lunar equinox in early 2028; an approximate seasonal reference, not an Artemis IV operations window.

seasons.name: South Pole Winter 2028
seasons.description: 30-day sample near the lunar South Pole southern winter maximum; an approximate seasonal reference, not an Artemis IV operations window.

sites.name: Shackleton Rim
sites.description: High-illumination crest on the rim of Shackleton Crater (Mazarico Site 4 vicinity), offering prolonged southern summer sunlight near shadowed crater interiors.

sites.name: Malapert Massif
sites.description: Prominent Earth-facing summit massif on the South Pole-Aitken basin rim (~5.2 km elevation) with favorable modeled Earth line-of-sight geometry.

sites.name: Nobile Rim 1
sites.description: Elevated highland massif along the western rim of Nobile Crater, combining high solar illumination with access to volatile-rich polar crater margins.

sites.name: Connecting Ridge
sites.description: Elevated ridge linking Shackleton and de Gerlache craters with an unobstructed negative-angle horizon across all azimuths.

sites.name: Peak Near Shackleton
sites.description: High-standing polar massif neighboring Shackleton Crater with favorable grazing-angle solar visibility.

sites.name: Deep Crater Floor
sites.description: Crater-floor comparison point inside Shackleton Crater located ~5.0 km from the modeled Shackleton Rim point, illustrating terrain occlusion in the selected seasonal windows.
